_doc: Anchored one-line edits to upstream files. Each hook inserts/replaces text next to an anchor that must occur EXACTLY ONCE in the upstream file. 'anchors' are tried in order, so add a fallback anchor when upstream code churns. If none match, the sync fails loudly and names the hook: nothing half-applied ever ships. Every inserted line is tagged USAGEOS-HOOK:<id> so check_extension.py can prove it's present.

anchors:
await conversationCache.set(conversationId, conversationData.toJSON(), CONVERSATION_CACHE_TTL);

	return true;
